title: Clann Lir Academy
specs: Academy Director is four-time World Irish Solo Dance Champion Anthony Fallon

includes: Qualified and certified Irish dance teachers (TCRG)

blurb: Clann Lir Academy offers Irish dance classes starting at age three, with levels from beginner to championship. Classes run on a trimester schedule with additional workshops and private lessons available. The Academy serves the South Shore of Massachusetts with studios in Hingham and Scituate.
extraNote: Tuition fees based on hours per week, prorated for mid-trimester starts · First class free for new Irish dance students · Dress rental may be required for competition with deposit · Trimester 1: September – December; Trimester 2: December – March; Trimester 3: March – June; Summer: Regular June classes and Summer Camps
